{{Quote|Come here, child. Do you intend to explore the Academy? To know the world that gave birth to the Sith? You should linger here a while. I am Overseer Ragate, a keeper of the old ways. I sense you have potential&mdash;and I can help you, if you like.|Overseer Ragate|audio=Ragate-KeeperOfTheOldWays-TOR.flac|<ref name="Blood Legacy" />}}
'''Ragate''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and an [[Overseer (Sith)|overseer]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Korriban Sith Academy]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], she administrated the [[rite of blood and bone]] at the Academy. Around [[3637 BBY]], Ragate was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a Republic strike team barged into the Academy.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I administer the Rite of blood and bone; a ritual performed beyond this doorway. It is a rite acolytes have participated in for ten thousand years.|Overseer Ragate|<ref name="Blood Legacy" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Ragate was a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. As an [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Ragate was tasked with instructing multiple [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. By the time of the [[Galactic War]], Overseer Ragate had become an old, frail-looking woman. As the administrator of the [[rite of blood and bone]], she supervised the test of many acolytes. During her tenure as administrator of the rite, Ragate supervised the tests of a [[Empire's Wrath|promising Sith warrior]] and of the soon-to-be [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]].<ref name="Blood Legacy" /> In [[3637 BBY]], the Republic devised a plan to retrieve a set of data from the [[Dark Council Chambers|chambers]] of the Empire's [[Dark Council]], which were located in the Sith Academy. When a group of four Republic heroes [[Korriban Incursion|broke into]] the Academy, Ragate and her fellow overseers tried to block access to the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] leading to the Dark Council chambers. However, the old overseer proved unable to stop the enemy strike team, and she [[Death/Legends|died]] defending the Sith Academy.<ref name="Assault Empire" />

==Personality and traits==
By the time of the Galactic War, Overseer Ragate was a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]], elderly woman with red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] who described herself as a guardian of ancient traditions.<ref name="Blood Legacy" /> Like other Sith Overseers, Ragate was harsh and cruel to her apprentices: while she was a young teacher, she took delight in cutting down the first acolyte to brake under her training, as a grim and effective warning to the surviving students.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
Ragate was skilled in [[Precognition/Legends|precognition]], as she could see glimpses of the future.<ref name="Blood Legacy" /> She wielded a single-bladed lightsaber with a yellow crystal in combat.<ref name="Assault Empire" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ragate is a non-player character in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. She is featured in the Korriban mission, "The Blood Legacy", exclusively for Sith Warriors and Sith Inquisitors, and later in the Republic flashpoint mission, "Korriban Incursion" as of '''Game Update 2.7: Invasion'''.

Among the conversation choices, the player can joke about Ragate's old age, implying she might have been beautiful millennia ago.<ref name="Blood Legacy" /> In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the character of [[Atton Rand]] made a similar mockery of [[Kreia]], stating that "She may have been good-looking once, but it takes some hard living to make creases like that."<ref name="KotOR II game">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

A non-player character with a similar character model to Ragate makes a brief cameo in the final cutscene of ''Legacy Reborn'', the finale of the expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', but it is unknown whether this character was intended to be Ragate herself, thus implying that she survived the events of the "Korriban Incursion" flashpoint, or a different character entirely.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
